items.source: An alternate approach to this application of an object creational pattern would be to use the ServiceLocatorFactoryBean to source (prototype) beans. The ServiceLocatorFactoryBean approach has the advantage of the fact that one doesn't have to depend on any Spring-specific interface such as ObjectFactory, but has the disadvantage of requiring runtime class generation. Please do consult the ServiceLocatorFactoryBean JavaDoc for a fuller discussion of this issue.
items.translation: 对象创建模式应用的另一种替代方法是使用 `ServiceLocatorFactoryBean` 来提供（原型化）bean。`ServiceLocatorFactoryBean` 方法的优势在于不需要依赖任何 Spring 特定的接口，例如 `ObjectFactory`，但其劣势是需要运行时类生成。请查阅 `ServiceLocatorFactoryBean JavaDoc` 以获取对此问题的更详细讨论。

items.source: As such, this may be used to avoid having a client object directly calling BeanFactory.getBean(String) to get a (typically prototype) bean from a BeanFactory, which would be a violation of the inversion of control principle. Instead, with the use of this class, the client object can be fed an ObjectFactory instance as a property which directly returns only the one target bean (again, which is typically a prototype bean).
items.translation: 因此，这可用于避免客户端对象直接调用 BeanFactory.getBean(String) 从 BeanFactory 获取（通常是原型）bean，这将违反控制反转原则。相反，使用此类时，客户端对象可以接收一个 ObjectFactory 实例作为属性，该实例直接返回唯一的目标 bean（同样，通常是原型 bean）。

items.source: The target does not have to be a non-singleton bean, but realistically always will be (because if the target bean were a singleton, then said singleton bean could simply be injected straight into the dependent object, thus obviating the need for the extra level of indirection afforded by this factory approach).
items.translation: 目标对象不必是非单例 Bean，但现实中几乎总是如此（因为如果目标 Bean 是单例的，那么该单例 Bean 可以直接注入到依赖对象中，从而消除了这种工厂方法所提供的额外一层间接性的需要）。
